gen-gf-fira-code-fs-merriweather-sans: Fira Code sets typewriter-spaced letters with generous room around each one. Merriweather Sans follows in sturdy, tall-lowercase words, so a long page of text feels chunky and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-fira-code-fs-supreme: Crisp and heavy-handed in the middle, Supreme gives text a dense strip while Fira Code hangs wide, typewriter-spaced letters above it. A longer page feels weighty yet open.
gen-gf-fira-code-gf-cascadia-mono: Pinned letters, compact and tidy. Fira Code spaces its typewriter letters loosely, while Cascadia Mono keeps curves as thick as stems, and that stroke sameness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-fira-code-montserrat: Montserrat glides along like wire, with oversized e and a counters and plenty of white space before each curve. And Fira Code's measured, typewriter-spaced letters make the strongest contrast to that flowing line.
gen-gf-fira-mono-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code runs on a wire-like monoline skeleton, with neighbors spaced far enough apart that you notice the gaps. Fira Mono's solid-block words oppose that.
gen-gf-fira-mono-montserrat: Fira Mono lays down solid blocks of words with wide white channels between letters, while Montserrat's round shapes look bent from wire. Montserrat softens the page below.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, and it earns its keep big and short. Be Vietnam Pro follows in strokes like bent steel rod, with a high mean line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-quicksand: Tall, rounded bowls like blown glass bulbs make Quicksand read softly, with terminals that finish well clear of the stem. And Funnel Display's commanding same-width strokes above it keep a longer page lively without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cascadia-code: Wiry and wide-spaced, this pairing feels drawn with a single thin rod: Funnel Display's spaghetti strokes sit over Cascadia Code's monoline skeleton. Bends stay smooth and unobstructed.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa reads with a clearly open lowercase e and tall counters and bowls. Funnel Display adds a commanding, same-width stroke, and that unchanging line weight against the body's modulation is the pair's strongest quality.
